ChildLinks.description: API paths for the frontend to follow (SRS FR-DASH-003).
ChildLinks.title: ChildLinks

FeeAmounts.description:
Money over a set of bills, two decimal places. `collected` is the sum of the
payments against those bills, whenever they were made.
FeeAmounts.title: FeeAmounts

FeeCreate.description:
Only these fields are accepted: the receipt number, dates and status are
server-owned.
FeeCreate.title: FeeCreate

FeeOut.description: A bill with its instalments, oldest first.
FeeOut.title: FeeOut

FeeSummary.description:
A bill and what has been paid against it. `amount_paid` is the sum of the
payments, never stored; `balance` and `status` come from `services.money`.
FeeSummary.title: FeeSummary

FeeTotals.description: Sums over every bill matching the filters, not just the current page.
FeeTotals.title: FeeTotals

FeesByPeriod.description:
`term` is for the selected term (None when there is no term); `all_time` spans
every term. They are never mixed.
FeesByPeriod.title: FeesByPeriod

LoginRequest.description: Only credentials are accepted: the role always comes from the database.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

ParentLinkCreate.description:
Links an existing parent-role account to a student. The relationship is free
text because the SRS defines no list of values.
ParentLinkCreate.title: ParentLinkCreate

PaymentCreate.description: An instalment on an existing bill. The receipt number and date are server-owned.
PaymentCreate.title: PaymentCreate

PublicStats.description:
Headline counts of active records for the public page. Counts only: no names,
ids or other personal data.
PublicStats.title: PublicStats

Receipt.description:
Printable receipt data (SRS FR-FEE-008). A bill receipt is numbered and dated
like the bill; an instalment receipt (`payment` set) like that payment, with the
figures as they stood once it was recorded.
Receipt.title: Receipt

ReceiptSignatures.description: Labels only: the frontend draws blank signature and stamp boxes to print.
ReceiptSignatures.title: ReceiptSignatures

ResultRow.description: One score in a class sheet listing.
ResultRow.title: ResultRow

ResultSheet.description: Everything FR-RES-009 lists, for the frontend to render and print.
ResultSheet.title: ResultSheet

ResultWrite.description:
One score for a student, subject and term. Out-of-range or over-precise scores
are rejected, never clamped or rounded.
ResultWrite.title: ResultWrite

StudentCreate.description: Only these fields are accepted: the number, status and flags are server-owned.
StudentCreate.title: StudentCreate

TeacherCreate.description: The teacher record is always linked to an existing teacher-role account.
TeacherCreate.title: TeacherCreate

TeacherOverview.description: "My overview": the teacher's own classes only. No fee or school-wide figures.
TeacherOverview.title: TeacherOverview

UserCreate.description: Administrators are created only through the CLI, never over HTTP.
UserCreate.title: UserCreate

get.description: Active classes the caller may reach: all for admins, assigned ones for teachers.

schema.title: Response List Classes Api V1 Classes Get

get.description:
Per-subject and overall averages. Teachers reach only their assigned classes and
see every subject there; parents get their child's figures via student results.

Role-specific overview for the selected term (default: the current term).
Admins get school-wide figures with fees for the term and for all time, kept
separate. Teachers get "My overview": their own classes only, no fees. Parents get their
linked children.

schema.title: Response Overview Api V1 Dashboard Overview Get

get.description: The fixed list of fee categories.

Admins see every bill; parents only their linked children's. `totals` cover all
bills matching the filters, not just this page.

post.description:
Bill a student, optionally recording a first payment. Amounts are naira with at
most two decimals; the receipt number and dates are assigned by the server.

get.description: One bill with its payments; a parent only gets their own child's.

post.description: Record an instalment. A payment that would exceed the amount billed is refused.

get.description: Receipt for one instalment, with the figures as they stood once it was paid.
Printable receipt data for a bill; a parent only gets their own child's.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

get.description: No login needed. Counts of active students, teachers and classes only.
Admins see every score; teachers only scores for classes and subjects they teach.

put.description: Create (201) or change (200) one score; repeating the same score is a no-op.

get.description: Admins see every student; teachers only those in their assigned classes.

schema.title: Response List Parents Api V1 Students  Student Id  Parents Get

get.description:
Printable term sheet with every subject. Admins and a student's linked parents
only: teachers see their own subjects through the student results endpoint.

A student's scores for a term: all subjects for admins and linked parents, only
the caller's own subjects for teachers.

schema.title: Response List Subjects Api V1 Subjects Get

get.description: Terms, newest academic year first and First to Third Term within a year.
